summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. raised the tender offer price for Kakaku.com from 3,681 yen to 3,682 yen per share, with the offer period extended by 10 business days to October 28, 2026, totaling 115 business days. The board's support for the transaction and recommendation to shareholders remain unchanged.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to "Notice of Board Opinion Supporting and Recommendation to Apply for Tender Offer by Kamgras 1 K.K. for Company Shares and Warrants"
translation_en_brief:
This disclosure announces a change to an ongoing tender offer for the delisting of Kakaku.com. Kamgras 1 K.K., the acquirer, increased the tender offer price by one yen from 3,681 yen to 3,682 yen per ordinary share on October 14, 2026. The price adjustment was made in connection with an extension of the tender offer period; the offer period was extended by 10 business days from the date of the amendment filing, now concluding on October 28, 2026, for a total of 115 business days.

The board of directors of Kakaku.com and the special committee established to evaluate the going-private transaction continue to engage in good-faith discussions with both Kamgras 1 K.K. and an alternative proposal by Bain Capital-advised investment funds and LINE Yahoo Corporation. The special committee is carefully examining which transaction would better serve the company's enterprise value and shareholders' common interests and whether the tender offer is likely to succeed.

As of the disclosure date, the board's special committee has not changed its advisory recommendation. The board maintains its support for the tender offer and leaves the decision whether to tender shares to shareholders. The status of support from warrant holders is similarly left to their discretion.
